text:
alex: quick kickoff for the soft-evict rollout plan. propose: 3 phases (internal smoke -> alpha tenants -> regional GA) + small quality A/B in phase 2. need owners for gates, fallback order, and preflight tests.

maria: can you list the concrete gate metrics?

alex: primary gates: p95 latency, p99 latency, 5xx rate, token-cost per request, and model-quality delta on our canary eval. proposed thresholds: p95 < 300ms for low-latency tenants / 350ms default, p99 < 1.2s, 5xx < 0.5%, cost delta < +15%, quality regression < 1% on canary promptset.

chen: how do we measure "quality regression"? need hallucination check + intent accuracy.
alex: use evals-prod harness with canary promptset. regression = relative drop in top-3 intent accuracy; additional hallucination score via heuristics + 50-sample human spot-check. if regression > 1% or hallucination score +0.5 -> rollback.

priya: suggested fallback order: 1) model-compact (less visible), 2) reduce concurrency / throttle burst, 3) region-redirect, 4) rollback to stable model.
deniz: +1. region-redirect is risky for stateful sessions so keep it later.

alex: we'll codify as ordered policy. sample YAML in rollout config: 

```yaml
rollout_policy:
  gates:
    - p95_latency_ms: 350
    - p99_latency_ms: 1200
    - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  fallback_order:
    - model: model-compact-v2
    - throttle: reduce_concurrency_30pct
    - region: fallback-region-eu
    - rollback: stable-model-v1
```

sam: add client header X-Redwood-Rollout: canary so analytics can split opt-ins. i'll add a lightweight routing tag too.

maria: what's the A/B split and evaluation window?
alex: phase2 (alpha tenants) will run 10% variant / 90% control for 48h, continuous eval. phase3 GA will promote progressively 25/50/75/100 with 24h waits and auto-revert on gate breach.

deploy-bot: deployment triggered for rollout-id=rr-soft-evict-2026-03-21 at 1799990150 :rocket:

priya: ops checklist: alerts for p99 & error %, traces at 10% sampling, token-cost dashboards, hourly eval runs, and a customer-ops bridge for alpha tenants.

chen: add a chaos preflight: simulate 20% tail slowdown for 30m in staging and confirm fallback triggers without user-visible 5xx.

alex: agreed. open items: (1) threshold sign-off (maria + deniz), (2) finalize canary promptset (chen), (3) add header & routing tag (sam), (4) customer support runbook (priya). i'll schedule a 30-min preflight tomorrow morning.

maria: sign-off with one tweak 12 lower p95 to 300ms for low-latency tenant group. otherwise +1.
deniz: +1; i'll validate region constraints with network.
sam: will push header + routing tag by EOD.

chen: finalizing promptset and human review batch by EOD.

priya: drafting support runbook and bridge template now.

alex: thanks all. i'll update the rollout PR and ping for preflight invite. :thumbsup:
